caption: Module 2, P liaG –RBS0–ccaS-m3–B0015. One of three colonies gave a band at 1,602 bp, and that clone went to sequencing.
Colony PCR for ccaSR–Csn–AcdS–Histag. Three of three colonies gave a band at 632 bp. Clones 3 and 5 went forward for the cross-module check.
Cross-module PCR for ccaSR–Csn–AcdS–Histag. Two of two clones gave a band at the expected size across all three junctions. Clone 2, at a vector to insert ratio of 1:7, was selected for sequencing.

Wild-type ACCD, construct ABDI, in B. subtilis  WB800 carrying CcaSR under different light intensities. (A) Green 100% and green 12%. (B) Green 2% and red 100%. M, molecular weight marker in kDa. Signals rose with time in green 100%, green 12% and green 2%, but not in an ordered way across intensities: green 2% was faint until 6 h, while green 12% at 8 h was the strongest of the green lanes. ACCD is about 35 kDa as a monomer and the bands ran near the 63 to 75 kDa markers; ACCD can also exist as a homodimer at about 70 kDa, so these bands may be the dimer. This is only a possibility, and we plan to validate it in future experiments.
P veg –EEBD–RBS0–SamyQ–BoPep4 2.1–Histag–B0015. One of eleven colonies at 678 bp; clone 14 sequenced.
Module 3, P veg –RBS0–ccaR–B0015. Two of four colonies gave a band at 1,442 bp. Clone 2 was selected for sequencing.

Western blot analysis of ACC deaminase secretion on 2 August 2026. P1 represents the total pellet, P2 the soluble pellet, and S the culture supernatant. Following a six-minute exposure, bands were detected only in the supernatant lanes, with molecular weight ladders spanning 28–180 kDa on both sides. This result is based on a single blot without a loading control, and the distinction between the two lanes labelled S was not documented.

P veg –EEBD–RBS0–Csn–LEA14–Histag–B0015. One colony at 735 bp, sequenced.
Cross-module PCR for ccaSR–SamyQ–AcdS 2.1–Histag. Three of three clones gave a band at the expected size across all modules. Clone 1 was selected for sequencing.

ACCD V2T1, construct ABDQ, after 13 and 16 h in the plate. G, green light; R, red light, both at 100%. A single band ran between the 75 and 100 kDa markers in all four lanes. The green lanes looked somewhat stronger than the red lanes at both times. Anti-His ELISA on these same four samples puts that difference at 12.9 against 11.8 µg/mL at 13 h and 12.5 against 12.1 µg/mL at 16 h: green is higher each time, with two samples a side and ranges that overlap.

ACCD V2T1 after an overnight culture of 16 h was moved into the plate under green light at 100%, sampled after 3, 6 and 8 h. A band ran just below the 100 kDa marker all three times. It was strong at 3 and 6 h and weaker at 8 h.

Module 1, P tagC +RBS–Ho1::pcyA–L3S2P21. Three of three colonies gave a band at the expected size, 1,145 bp. Clone 1 was selected for sequencing.
